method: 169 no-dcterms:source legacy roots enumerated; 5-agent classification + mechanical label/slug/paragraph-range verification; duplicate = same statute (orthography/truncation/renaming variants), legal succession deliberately NOT treated as duplication

policy.deprecate: root gets owl:deprecated=true + dcterms:isReplacedBy=<canonical root IRI>; file kept; inbound references to the legacy root IRI re-pointed to the canonical IRI corpus-wide; excluded from INDEX total_laws/total_files via deprecated_laws section
policy.keep: sole representations (real in-force/repealed/historical statutes incl. legal-succession predecessors) stay canonical and counted
